template: Create a NEW dashboard in Grafana. Requirements: (1) Add a visualization panel using the 'TestData DB' data source (the TestData data source). (2) Change the panel's visualization type to 'Stat'. (3) Set the panel title to exactly: {{v2}}. (4) Apply the panel. (5) Save the dashboard with the dashboard title exactly: {{v3}}. (6) Verify the save succeeded (no unsaved-changes indicator, dashboard title shown in the top bar) and report the dashboard's URL from the browser address bar. Leave the dashboard open.

target.selector: div > div:nth-of-type(1) > header > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(3) > button:nth-of-type(1)

addedContains: - menu "New dashboard Import dashboard New alert rule"
